question: Does a frozen native-01 AE1 student generalize copying answer-bearing second word b beyond values b=0..5 trained in that role, as opposed to merely recombining familiar values?
single_variable: Only b changes within each fixed a,c,d,r and model; exhaustive legal b=0..29, with old role-exposed 0..5, previously seen only in nuisance c/d position 6..14, and entirely train-unseen 15..29.

legal_profile.name: SLE-AE1-n5-v1
legal_profile.A: first r full six-bit data words followed by external STOP S

original_training.train_val_test: a,b in 0..5, split by (a+b)%6: val0,test1,otherwise train

test_design.anchors: all six original test (a,b0) for a=0..5 where (a+b0)%6=1; c=15+(7a+3b0)%15,d=15+(5a+11b0)%15
test_design.values_b: enumerate all integers 0..29 for each anchor
test_design.r1: negative control; correct answer ignores b, assess invariance/first word
test_design.r2: target should follow the value of b
test_design.n: 4 frozen checkpoints * 6 anchors * 30 b values * 2 r = 1440 responses

groups.0-5: known second-position vocabulary; train/val/test pair membership separately
groups.6-14: not seen in b during training; may appear in nuisance c/d as raw input
groups.15-29: not seen in any training payload positions; test suffix may contain this value; report collisions b=c or b=d separately

pre_run_gates: Read exact Git blob ids for all 4 checkpoints and source 864 archived predictions from immutable PR29 ref; reject mismatch
Independent JS float32 dense-tanh inference must reproduce all 864 archived outputs exactly before any new 1440 interventions
Assert Q length39, pure raw 01 input, legal 6-bit data words 0..29, fixed a,c,d,r and differences confined to b slot
Evaluate all four checkpoints, all six anchors, every b 0..29, r1 and r2; no seed, b or epoch selection by observed results
Preserve all generated Q,expected,actual and all failures
metrics: per-model and aggregate full exact, r1 first word, r2 first/second words, stop position, cap/overflow by b group
within original known b=0..5, separate original train/val/test pair membership
r2 for novel 15..29 separately with b equal to nuisance c/d and b not equal (collision exclusion for primary novelty measure)
r1 answer invariance across b relative to anchor baseline
groupwise first error bit/word and representative failures

resources.count_actual_forward_and_MAC: include 864 source replays plus new responses; record separately
